subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: setCommonConfig does not forward live_preview to Contentstack queries. AC3 explicitly states the ICommonContentstackConfig.live_preview field exists 'so preview context (live_preview/preview_hash) can flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig.' The interface field was added but setCommonConfig only destructures { referenceFieldPath, only, except } — live_preview is never read or passed to the query object. The field is dead code: preview context can never reach a Contentstack query, defeating the purpose of AC3.
issues.suggestedFix: In setCommonConfig, destructure live_preview from config and pass it to the query. For example: `const { referenceFieldPath, only, except, live_preview } = config;` then `if (live_preview) { query.addParam('live_preview', JSON.stringify(live_preview)); }` (or whatever the Contentstack SDK query API expects for preview context propagation). Add a corresponding unit test verifying that when live_preview is passed in config, it reaches the query.

issues.description: `options as any` is an untyped any without an explanatory comment, violating TypeScript strict compliance. The cast was added because the contentstack SDK's TypeScript types likely don't include live_preview in its Stack options type, but per review criteria any untyped any requires an explanatory comment.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace `options as any` with a properly typed cast or add an inline comment explaining why the cast is necessary, e.g. `// contentstack SDK types don't include live_preview; cast to satisfy TS` or define a local type extension: `contentstack.Stack(options as Parameters<typeof contentstack.Stack>[0] & { live_preview?: { enable: boolean; preview_token: string } })`.

issues.description: The live_preview type in ICommonContentstackConfig includes enable, preview_hash, live_preview, and content_type_uid — but not preview_token. While query-level preview context may differ from Stack-init options, this creates an inconsistency: the options object's live_preview has preview_token but the interface's live_preview does not. If preview_token ever needs to flow through queries, it would require another interface change.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `preview_token?: string` to the live_preview type in ICommonContentstackConfig for completeness and consistency, or document why it's intentionally excluded at the query level.
